$comment: Corrections to the vendored timeseries.jsonschema.json (foundation-sdk v0.0.20). Sources are Grafana's CUE at the tag in `grafana`. See src/spec/overlay.ts.

multiLane.description: Breaks out each annotation frame into multiple lanes on the x-axis

clustering.description: Sets whether clustering is enabled. Any value > 0 will enable clustering.

patches.why: The time series CUE embeds common.OptionsWithAnnotations and declares annotations (public/app/plugins/panel/timeseries/panelcfg.cue:32 and :38); the vendored schema has no such type.
Same: the vendored Options has timezone, legend, tooltip and orientation but not annotations.

value.description: Show point values on the graph.

patches.why: In GraphFieldConfig since 12.4; Grafana writes it into every time series panel's fieldConfig.defaults.custom.
Grafana 13 adds the "accessible" line style; the vendored enum rejects it.
